arxiv-2211-12113.title: Role of neutron transfer in the reaction mechanism of 9 Be+ 169 Tm, 181 Ta, 187 Re and 197 Au systems Journal: Nuclear Physics A
arxiv-2211-12113.creator: Prasanna M, V. V. Parkar, V. Jha, A. Parmar, Bhushan. A. Kanagalekar, B. G. Hegde
arxiv-2211-12113.description: Abstract The contribution of one neutron stripping cross section to the total reaction cross section has been studied for 9 Be projectile incident on 169 Tm, 181 Ta, 187 Re and 197 Au targets around Coulomb barrier energy. The measured one neutron stripping cross sections for these systems have been compared with the coupled channel calculations.

arxiv-2401-07046.title: How quarks made their entrance into our worldview via cosmic rays and proton accelerators
arxiv-2401-07046.creator: Jos Engelen
arxiv-2401-07046.description: Abstract 1964: a new layer in the structure of matter Sixty years ago Gell-Mann introduced, with a striking sense of caution, a new fundamental layer in the structure of matter. He christened the associated particles ‘quarks’, a name borrowed from the psychedelic flood of words of James Joyce’s novel Finnegans Wake. Independently and simultaneously, Zweig arrived at similar ideas.

arxiv-2406-00686.title: On the number of real zeroes of a homogeneous differential polynomial and a generalization of the Hawaii conjecture
arxiv-2406-00686.creator: Olga Katkova, Mikhail Tyaglov, Anna Vishnyakova
arxiv-2406-00686.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Olga Katkova, Mikhail Tyaglov, Anna Vishnyakova. For a given real polynomial p p we study the possible number of real roots of a differential polynomial H ϰ ​ [ p ] ​ ( x ) = ϰ ​ ( p ′ ​ ( x ) ) 2 − p ⁡ ( x ) ​ p ′′ ​ ( x ) , ϰ ∈ ℝ . arxiv-2409-03495.title: Maximum likelihood inference for high-dimensional problems with multiaffine variable relations footnoteinfo
arxiv-2409-03495.creator: Jean-Sébastien Brouillon, Florian Dörfler, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate
arxiv-2409-03495.description: Abstract Maximum Likelihood Estimation of continuous variable models can be very challenging in high dimensions, due to potentially complex probability distributions. The existence of multiple interdependencies among variables can make it very difficult to establish convergence guarantees. This leads to a wide use of brute-force methods, such as grid searching and Monte-Carlo sampling and, when applicable, complex and problem-specific algorithms.

arxiv-2410-04687.title: Uni-polarized RIS Beamforming for Improving Connectivity of Multi-RIS-Assisted D2D Networks Thanks: This work was supported in part by funding from the Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security (IDEaS) program from the Department of National Defence (DND).
arxiv-2410-04687.creator: Mohammed Saif, Mohammad Javad-Kalbasi, and Shahrokh Valaee
arxiv-2410-04687.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel method to enhance the connectivity of multi-reconfigurable intelligent surface-assisted device-to-device networks, referred to as multi-RIS-assisted D2D networks, through a unique phase shift determination. The proposed method aims to optimize the power-domain array factor (PDAF), targeting specific azimuth angles of reliable user equipments (UEs) and enhancing network connectivity.

arxiv-2505-24295.title: 5G RAN Slicing with Load Balanced Handovers
arxiv-2505-24295.creator: Yongzhou Chen 1 , Muhammad Taimoor Tariq 1 , Haitham Hassanieh 2 , Radhika Mittal 1 1 UIUC, 2 EPFL
arxiv-2505-24295.description: Abstract Abstract. With increasing density of small cells in modern multi-cell deployments, a given user can have multiple options for its serving cell. The serving cell for each user must be carefully chosen such that the user achieves reasonably high channel quality from it, and the load on each cell is well balanced.

arxiv-2507-03508.title: From localized 4 ​ f 4f electrons to anisotropic exchange interactions in ferromagnetic CeRh 6 ​ Ge 4 \text{CeRh}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{6}}}\text{Ge}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{4}}}
arxiv-2507-03508.creator: Shoichiro Itokazu, Akimitsu Kirikoshi, Harald O. Jeschke, Junya Otsuki
arxiv-2507-03508.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shoichiro Itokazu, Akimitsu Kirikoshi, Harald O. Jeschke, Junya Otsuki. CeRh 6 ​ Ge 4 \text{CeRh}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{6}}}\text{Ge}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{4}}} is a Ce-based ferromagnetic material exhibiting a quantum critical behavior under pressure. We derive effective exchange interactions, using the framework of density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory. Our results reveal that the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic interaction along the c c -axis is isotropic in spin space, leading to a formation of spin chains.

arxiv-2512-16193.title: Emergence of higher-order interactions in systems of coupled Kuramoto oscillators with time delay
arxiv-2512-16193.creator: Narumi Fujii, Keisuke Taga, Riccardo Muolo, Bob Rink, Hiroya Nakao
arxiv-2512-16193.description: Abstract Understanding the mechanisms that govern collective synchronization is a paramount task in nonlinear dynamics. While higher-order (many-body) interactions have recently emerged as a powerful framework for capturing collective behaviors, real-world examples regarding dynamics remain scarce. Here, we show that higher-order interactions naturally emerge from time-delayed pairwise coupling in Kuramoto oscillators.

Estrogen deficiency causes bone loss and postmenopausal osteoporosis, the pathogenesis of which also involves oxidative...

pmc-10573065.title: Depressed Mood as a Significant Risk Factor for Gynecological Cancer Aggravation
pmc-10573065.creator: Seon-Mi Lee, Jae-Yun Song, Aeran Seol, Sanghoon Lee, Hyun-Woong Cho, Kyung-Jin Min, Jin-Hwa Hong, Jae-Kwan Lee, Nak-Woo Lee
pmc-10573065.description: Background: The aim of this study was to evaluate the relationship between depressed mood and gynecological cancer outcomes, identifying risk factors for cancer aggravation. Methods: This study was a retrospective analysis of gynecological cancer patients (January 2020–August 2022) at Korea University Anam Hospital using Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9). Patients were classified into non-depressed mood (NDM)- and depressed mood (DM)-based scores.

pmc-10611235.title: Exposure of Reproductive-Aged Women to Multiple Metals and Its Associations with Unexplained Recurrent Miscarriage
pmc-10611235.creator: Yingying Zhang, Xi Yan, Jianhua Tan, Jifan Tan, Chunsheng Liu, Pan Yang, Yanping Xian, Qiong Wang, Jodi Flaws
pmc-10611235.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Exposure to heavy metals exerts toxic effects on female reproduction and embryo development. This study examined the exposure of patients with unexplained recurrent miscarriage (uRM) to multiple metals and the correlations among exposures to different metals. A total of 275 participants were enrolled, including 43 healthy women without previous miscarriage (the control group) and 232 uRM women (the case group); among these uRM women, 159 had two miscarriages (2M), 42 had three miscarriages (3M) and 31 had four or more miscarriages (≥4M).

pmc-11306075.title: Sex-specific association of circulating Isthmin-1 with isolated post-challenge hyperglycemia
pmc-11306075.creator: Jiahua Fan, Jialin He, Jiangyuan Zhu, Jialu Yang, Jingmeng Ju, Jingyi Huang, Zhihao Huang, Zhuoyu Zhang, Wenkang Li, Min Xia, Yan Liu
pmc-11306075.description: IntroductionTo explore the distribution of Isthmin-1 (ISM1) level and its association with isolated post-challenge hyperglycemia (IPH).MethodsA total of 522 participants without a history of diabetes were invited to attend a standard 75g 2-h oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), and 71 subjects were further invited for a 3-h oral minimal model test.

pmc-11395659.title: Fracture resistance and fractographic analysis of pressable glass-ceramics with different partial coverage designs for maxillary premolars
pmc-11395659.creator: Abdelaziz M. Abdelaal, Hany A. Kehela, Ahmed A. Holiel
pmc-11395659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundPartial coverage concepts have met the main goal of conservative dentistry. Vonlays, which combine features of veneers and onlays, are a recent alternative to full coverage designs and overlay partial coverage restorations. This in vitro study was conducted to compare the fracture resistance of the newly introduced pressable zirconia-reinforced lithium silicate with pressable lithium disilicate ceramic and to determine the optimal preparation design for partial coverage on upper premolars.MethodsFifty-two duplicated epoxy resin dies were prepared following vonlay and overlay preparation guidelines.

pmc-11433562.title: The Utilization of Carbonated Steel Slag as a Supplementary Cementitious Material in Cement
pmc-11433562.creator: Xinyue Liu, Pengfei Wu, Xiaoming Liu, Zengqi Zhang, Xianbin Ai
pmc-11433562.description: Carbon emission reduction and steel slag (SS) treatment are challenges in the steel industry. The accelerated carbonation of SS and carbonated steel slag (CSS) as a supplementary cementitious material (SCM) in cement can achieve both large-scale utilization of SS and CO2 emission reduction, which is conducive to low-carbon sustainable development. This paper presents the utilization status of CSS.

pmc-11435854.title: Autonomous Planetary Liquid Sampler (APLS) for In Situ Sample Acquisition and Handling from Liquid Environments
pmc-11435854.creator: Miracle Israel Nazarious, Leonie Becker, Maria-Paz Zorzano, Javier Martin-Torres, Remco J Wiegerink
pmc-11435854.description: Many natural and artificial liquid environments, such as rivers, oceans, lakes, water storage tanks, aquariums, and urban water distribution systems, are difficult to access. As a result, technology is needed to enable autonomous liquid sampling to monitor water quality and ecosystems.

pmc-11511741.title: Authors’ Reply to Wang et al., “Comment on ‘Efficacy and Safety of Brodalumab, an Anti‑interleukin‑17 Receptor A Monoclonal Antibody, for Palmoplantar Pustulosis: 16‑Week Results of a Randomized Clinical Trial’”
pmc-11511741.creator: Yukari Okubo, Satomi Kobayashi, Masamoto Murakami, Shigetoshi Sano, Natsuko Kikuta, Yoshiumi Ouchi, Tadashi Terui
pmc-11511741.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). d clinical trial (RCT) was to assess the efficacy and safety of brodalumab, an anti‑interleukin (IL)‑17 receptor A monoclonal antibody, in Japanese patients with palmoplantar pustulosis (PPP) having moderate or severe pustules/vesicles. The primary efficacy endpoint was met; the change from baseline in PPP Area Severity Index (PPPASI) total score at week 16 was significantly higher in the brodalumab group than the placebo group. Infection was the dominant event among treatment-emergent adverse events (AEs).

pmc-11538609.title: Th Pathways in Immune-Mediated Skin Disorders: A Guide for Strategic Treatment Decisions
pmc-11538609.creator: Reinhart Speeckaert, Arno Belpaire, Jo Lambert, Marijn Speeckaert, Nanja van Geel
pmc-11538609.description: In recent years, there have been significant breakthroughs in the identification of immunological components of skin diseases and in the development of immunomodulatory drugs. Novel therapies create exciting prospects for personalized care. This article provides an overview of the role played by Th1, Th2, Th17, and follicular Th pathways in the most common skin diseases.

pmc-11643066.title: Styrene–Butadiene Rubber Latex Modified Mortars Prepared with High Early Strength Portland Cement
pmc-11643066.creator: Modestas Kligys, Giedrius Girskas, Carlos Leiva
pmc-11643066.description: The increased early hydration rate of high early strength cement has economic advantages in many civil engineering fields (faster formwork removal or earlier demoulding of precast elements). Styrene–butadiene rubber (SBR) latex is the most common polymer in aqueous dispersions suitable for admixing in cement-based materials. It allows the designing of structures with specific properties for a variety of applications.

pmc-12616917.title: Meningeal vascular Aβ deposition associates with cerebral hypoperfusion and compensatory collateral remodeling
pmc-12616917.creator: Alexandra M. Kaloss, Jack L. Browning, Jiangtao Li, Yuhang Pan, Sachi Watsen, Harald Sontheimer, Michelle H. Theus, Michelle L. Olsen
pmc-12616917.description: BackgroundGlobal reductions in cerebral blood flow (CBF) are among the earliest and most consistent abnormalities observed in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), preceding both cortical plaque formation and cognitive decline. While the pial arterial network—a critical supplier of intracortical perfusion—has been overlooked in this context, it may play a pivotal role in early vascular pathology.

pmc-12651022.title: Strong Local Passivity in Unconventional Scenarios: A New Protocol for Amplified Quantum Energy Teleportation
pmc-12651022.creator: Songbo Xie, Manas Sajjan, Sabre Kais
pmc-12651022.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Quantum energy teleportation (QET) has been proposed to overcome the restrictions of strong local passivity (SLP) and to facilitate energy transfer in quantum systems. Traditionally, QET has only been considered under strict constraints, including the requirements that the initial state be the ground state of an interacting Hamiltonian, that Alice’s measurement commute with the interaction terms, and that entanglement be present. These constraints have significantly limited the broader applicability of QET protocols.

pmc-13164930.title: Study on D6AC Steel PCBN Hard Turning and Optimization
pmc-13164930.creator: Yihan Liu, Shutao Huang, Ruyu Li, Zhonghan Cui, Yupu Zhang, Chengwei Liu
pmc-13164930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This investigation uses polycrystalline cubic boron nitride (PCBN) tools for precision turning of D6AC (45CrNiMoVA) hardened steel, thereby enabling the manufacturing of components that meet the requirements of intelligent manufacturing lines. A Taguchi’s L16 (43) orthogonal design was employed to systematically investigate the effects of cutting speed, depth of cut, and feed rate on cutting force, cutting temperature, surface roughness, and tool wear.

pmc-13375534.title: Oligonucleotide–siRNA conjugate for SOD1 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a phase 1 trial
pmc-13375534.creator: Weiqi Chen, Lingling Jiang, Chunling Duan, Moorim Kang, Jinyi Ye, Ling Wang, Yuesong Pan, Hui Qu, Xiaoling Liao, Xuejiao Zhou, Yichen Li, Zubao Gan, Junnan Chen, Ian Schacht, Robert F. Place, Long-Cheng Li, Yilong Wang
pmc-13375534.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease partly caused by gain-of-function mutations in superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1). Here we developed RAG-17, an siRNA-targeting SOD1, using an accessory oligonucleotide conjugate platform for enhanced central nervous system (CNS) delivery. Preclinically, RAG-17 rescued motor neuron degeneration, delayed disease progression, preserved motor function and extended survival in SOD1G93A ALS rodents, even with advanced-stage treatment. In cynomolgus monkeys, intrathecal RAG-17 led to dose-dependent, durable reductions in SOD1 mRNA (CNS) and protein (cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)).

pmc-13388435.title: Four weeks of romosozumab treatment increases trabecular bone volume and differentially improves cortical bone in young and aging mice with chronic kidney disease
pmc-13388435.creator: Corinne E. Metzger, Allison R. Kolhouse, Joana Santamaria Vilchis, Samantha P. Tippen, Landon Y. Tak, Alec N. LaPlant, Olivia N. White, Joseph M. Wallace, Matthew R. Allen
pmc-13388435.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) leads to significant bone loss and high risk of fractures. Fractures are even more prevalent in the aging population with CKD. Cortical bone is particularly impacted in CKD due to cortical thinning and the development of cortical porosity.

pmc-13503281.title: Modeling the dynamics of human starvation: incorporating lessons from famines past and present
pmc-13503281.creator: Alexandra M Thorn, Merry Fitzpatrick
pmc-13503281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Famines are crises characterized by starvation and malnutrition-related mortality. But representative nutrition and mortality data is often impossible to collect under common famine conditions, impeding real-time estimations and near-term projections of famine severity and therefore allocation of humanitarian assistance. As a supplement to survey data, systems models may be able to project individual outcomes based on more readily available data, to guide food assistance rations, and to predict trajectories of population-level malnutrition and starvation mortality.

pmc-13587502.title: Analysis of whole-exome sequencing data from nearly 10,000 Iranian individuals: identification of recessive mitochondrial disease variants and proposal of a population-specific carrier screening panel
pmc-13587502.creator: Mohadeseh Fathi, Parvaneh Karimzadeh, Farzad Ahmadabadi, Damoun Nashta Ali, Narjes Jafari, Raheleh Tangestani, Shadab Salehpour, Toktam Moosavian, Soudeh Ghafouri-Fard, Mohammad Miryounesi
pmc-13587502.description: BackgroundMitochondrial diseases, often stemming from recessive nuclear gene mutations, represent a heterogeneous group of disorders with significant morbidity and mortality. Carrier screening for these conditions is population-specific, yet data on the pathogenic variant burden in the Iranian population remain limited.

pmc-13634138.title: Stunting and thinness among adolescents residing in Jazan City, Saudi Arabia: a school-based cross-sectional study using WHO AnthroPlus
pmc-13634138.creator: Ebtihal Elameen Eltyeb, Ali Ali Al-Makramani
pmc-13634138.description: BACKGROUND: Adolescence is a critical period of growth and development during which nutritional deficiencies may adversely affect health outcomes throughout adulthood.OBJECTIVES: To determine the prevalence of stunting and thinness among adolescents in Jazan city, Saudi Arabia, using the WHO AnthroPlus growth reference, and to identify associated sociodemographic factors.

uslaw-usc-t12-s2284.title: 12 U.S.C. § 2284 — Board of Directors
uslaw-usc-t12-s2284.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s2284.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 24 (Federal Financing Bank). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Bank shall have a Board of Directors consisting of five persons, one of whom shall be the Secretary of the Treasury as Chairman of the Board, and four of whom shall be appointed by the President from among the officers or employees.
